gancho: Pele falls into a deep sleep in a cave in Puna, and her spirit follows the sound of far-off hula drums across the whole island chain, to a dance hall on Kauaʻi. There she meets the young chief Lohiʻau, stays three days, and promises to send for him. Based on N. B. Emerson, Pele and Hiiaka (1915), and W. D. Westervelt, Hawaiian Legends of Volcanoes (1916).
